title: Who the national debt is actually owed to (percent)

source.name: Monthly Debt Update, August 2026
source.publisher: U.S. Congress Joint Economic Committee (Republicans), citing U.S. Treasury data

notes: Of the $39.83 trillion gross national debt (Aug 2026), $32.10 trillion (80.6%) is debt held by the public (outside investors, foreign governments, funds), and $7.73 trillion (19.4%) is intragovernmental debt the government owes to its own trust funds (e.g. Social Security).
